messages:
sara: Pushing this up — ACME reporting a sudden spike of 429s on their dedicated pool overnight (around 00:30-01:15 UTC). They say it started after a campaign deploy.
jin: On it. Any repro or logs from their side?
customer-sre: We captured traces and a few curl samples. Mostly auth failures (429) then short bursts of 500s.
customer-sre: Example curl -> `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -d '{\"input\":\"x\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 429 response with `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`
alex: Did they hit an unexpected QPS spike or token issue? What's their baseline vs peak?
customer-sre: Baseline ~120 qps, peak during campaign ~1600 qps sustained for ~20m. Their dedicated pool is 8-GPU (N4) reserved. Target util set to 75%.
mirek: That 8-GPU pool at 75% util and 120 baseline seems undersized for 1.6k burst depending on model. Which model/sequence lengths?
customer-sre: Using rwd-3b, avg seq 256, request concurrency spiky (many concurrent short requests).
jin: Sounds like autoscaler didn't react fast enough; may be hitting queue throttles + auth fallback. Can we get the trace IDs from their client?
customer-sre: Pasted two trace IDs: trace-01a2, trace-01a3. Also see repeated `KV cache miss` and long prefix compile logs in runtime.
sara: Customer says billing system also blocked tokens because a per-minute token cap was reached and they saw "billing limit exceeded" in some responses.
alex: Okay: two failure modes — (1) auth/rate-limit bump to 429 at router because backend pool exhausted, (2) billing cap overlapping causing extra 429s. Need repro steps + a plan.
mirek: Repro plan suggestion: 1) run synthetic load from our staging in their region matching 1.6k qps sustained with rwd-3b, seq 256; 2) monitor per-GPU token/sec, queue depth, autoscale events; 3) toggle target_util from 75->60 to observe headroom.
jin: Quick commands I'll run in staging: ```hey -n 200000 -c 1600 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -D hdrs.txt https://staging.redwood/v1/generate```
ops-bot: deploy-bot started a canary of autoscaler tweak onto staging at 2025-11-03T01:12:00Z :rocket:
customer-sre: We can allow a temporary increase to 16 GPUs for tonight to mitigate. Need guidance on warmup/warm-cache steps.
sara: Thanks. Provide warmup script and target window. Also want a short RCA template for the customer.
alex: Warmup snippet: ```for model in rwd-3b; do for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"input":"warmup"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate > /dev/null; done; done``` Run for ~15-20 minutes after scale up. That should populate KV cache and avoid compile stalls.
mirek: Also recommend changing autoscale policy: lower scale-up cooldown 90s -> 30s, add burst buffer of 2 GPUs, and set target_util to 60%. We'll A/B on staging first.
jin: I'll run the synthetic test after autoscaler tweak and post perf counters (qps, avg latency p50/p95, queue depth, tokens/sec per GPU).
customer-sre: We'll accept a temporary 16-GPU bump tonight and run the warmup. Please DM the support key rotation step after.
sara: I'll coordinate billing override for tonight to prevent the per-minute cap from firing. Added to this thread: @mirek @jin follow up with logs and timeline.
jin: Test started. Initial results: at 1.6k rps staging hit queue depth 300, avg latency p95 1.8s, tokens/sec/GPU spiked then stabilized after warmup. No 429s after warmup. Full logs in staging-run-1758456123.log
ops-bot: alert-bot: staging autoscaler event: +4 GPUs at 00:34:12 UTC -> +6 GPUs at 00:36:05 UTC
mirek: Good. Early takeaway: primary issue was insufficient headroom + autoscale cooldown too long for this short, high-concurrency campaign. Secondary issue was billing cap overlapping. Recommend customer reserve larger burst slab (or lower target_util) for campaign windows.
sara: I'll send customer a short remediation email: (1) temporary 16-GPU bump + warmup steps, (2) autoscale tuning options, (3) billing cap override, (4) follow-up capacity plan.
customer-sre: Appreciate the quick triage. We'll run tonight and report back in morning (their timezone). :pray:
alex: Adding a runbook note for support: `dedicated-campaign-warmup.md` -> steps + common mitigations (lower target_util, warmup script, billing override).
sara: Closing interim here — will reopen if 429s reappear. Thanks team :thumbsup:
